create_CudaCommunicator: create a CudaCommunicator instance with a ProcessGroup for distributed GPU all-reduce operations
run_CudaCommunicator_all_reduce: run the all_reduce method on a CudaCommunicator to perform distributed tensor reduction across GPUs
run_CudaCommunicator_reduce_scatter: run the reduce_scatter method on a CudaCommunicator to scatter reduced tensor chunks across ranks
run_CudaCommunicator_all_gatherv: run the all_gatherv method on a CudaCommunicator to gather tensors of varying sizes from all ranks
run_CudaCommunicator_dispatch: run the dispatch method on a CudaCommunicator to route hidden states and topk ids via all2all manager
